label: Telemetry Pipeline
info:
Subscribes to iot/# on Mosquitto, parses measurement topics, and writes to InfluxDB.
Lifecycle topics (status, events, commands) are silently dropped.
Malformed messages are caught and logged to the debug panel.

label: Email Alerts
info:
Flow A: Twice-daily sensor summary email (08:00 and 20:00).
Flow B: Watchdog — alerts once when data stops for 1 hour, once when it resumes. State machine: no repeated emails.
Flow C: MQTT heartbeat — updates gateway online state from retained status topic.
Both send via Gmail. Configure credentials in the email node.

label: OpenWeatherMap
info:
Polls OWM current weather and 5-day/3h forecast every 30 minutes.
Stores results in InfluxDB measurements: weather_current and weather_forecast.
Errors are logged to the debug panel; InfluxDB write is skipped on failure.
